seoTitle: Free CSS Speech Bubble & Tooltip Generator
metaDescription: Create a pure CSS speech bubble or tooltip with a tail on any side, border, radius and shadow. Live preview and copy-ready CSS. Free.
intro: Design a speech bubble or tooltip with a triangle tail on any side and get the CSS, built from pseudo-elements, with adjustable colours, border, radius, tail size and offset.
why:
A tail on a chat bubble or tooltip is usually a CSS triangle drawn with borders, and when the bubble also has a border of its own you need a second triangle behind the first to fake the outline. It is a well-known trick that is tedious to redo every time the colour or side changes.

This generator writes both pseudo-elements for you. Choose the side the tail points from, set its size and how far along the edge it sits, add a border colour and a shadow, and the live preview shows the result. The output is a single bubble rule, so it drops into any stylesheet without images or JavaScript. The code is produced in your browser and nothing is uploaded.
howTo: Choose the side where the tail should appear: top, bottom, left or right.
Set background, text and border colours, border width and corner radius.
Adjust tail size and offset in percent, and tick the drop shadow if you want one.
Copy the .bubble CSS into your stylesheet and add the class to your element.

faq.a: The border triangle technique needs one triangle in the border colour and a slightly smaller one in the fill colour on top. Without a border, the outline triangle is simply not visible.

faq.q: Can the tail point at a specific element?
faq.a: The tail offset is a percentage along the bubble edge, so you can line it up with a button or avatar. For a tooltip that must follow its target, position the bubble with your own JavaScript or CSS anchor positioning.

faq.q: Does a shadow also follow the tail?
faq.a: A box-shadow follows the rectangle only, not the tail. If the shadow around the tail looks missing, a filter drop-shadow on the bubble is an alternative you can try by hand.
